description: Ask the user a question with 2 to 4 answer buttons. It appears as a card at the top of Study in DayHeart (or Tasks, when Study is off), with a push notification or a bot message; the user taps an answer, and the card disappears. The user may also close it without answering; a question not answered in 7 days expires. Up to 10 questions can wait at once; the same question is not asked twice while waiting, and a source_key that was already asked is never asked again: you get that question back with its answer — use a new source_key for a new question.

options.description: 2 to 4 short answers, up to 40 characters each, e.g. ["Yes, the whole group", "Only me"]

question.description: The question, up to 300 characters, e.g. "Notes for Anatomy, topic 9 are ready. Share them with the group?"

source_key.description: Id of what the question is about, e.g. moodle:4512; a key already asked returns that question and its answer instead of asking again

subject.description: The subject the question is about, if any

name: ask_user
title: Ask the user
